basics.name: Evan Reynolds
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software engineer with 5 years building the data infrastructure behind enterprise payroll. Currently the sole engineer running HCA Healthcare's Badge Pay platform, a badge-based payment system used across 250+ facilities that processes over $5M in payroll deductions each month. Strong in Python, SQL and ETL pipeline development, with earlier experience building backend APIs and a recent focus on modernizing legacy COBOL systems. Now focused on agentic engineering: shipping full-stack systems by directing AI coding agents with specs, guardrails and automated verification.

work.name: HCA Healthcare
work.summary: Sole engineer running Badge Pay: 250+ facilities, ~146,000 employees a month and over $5M in monthly payroll deductions.
highlights: Sole engineer owning HCA's Badge Pay program end to end: a badge-based payment system for cafeterias, gift shops and retail across 250+ facilities, used by ~146,000 employees monthly and generating over $5M in monthly payroll deductions.
Designed and maintained Python + Airflow ETL pipelines that process financial transactions and employee data, integrating vendor systems with internal payroll infrastructure.
Built and maintained automated SFTP/FTP workflows and SQL transformations that ensure accurate, timely payroll deductions from badge transactions.
Built Power BI dashboards for Lawson payroll badge-pay processing, monitoring intake, load outcomes and deduction reconciliation across HR entities.

Used GitHub Copilot to document and modernize legacy custom COBOL programs supporting Infor Lawson Payroll, improving maintainability and delivering overdue process improvements to outdated workflows.
Worked within CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps integrated with GitHub, using pull requests and automated builds to deliver payroll application changes to production.

work.name: Momentum Technology
work.summary: Integrated Sift AI fraud detection into the backend, driving a 20% revenue increase in the first month.
highlights: Built and shipped RESTful APIs across development, QA and production environments, validating functionality and performance with Postman.
Led development of in-app multimedia messaging and integrated Hive AI Visual Moderation for automated content moderation.
Integrated Sift AI into the backend to reduce fraudulent transactions and grant verified-safe users access to expanded paid features, driving a 20% revenue increase in the first month.
Designed and optimized SQL/PostgreSQL databases for data integrity and performance at scale.
Queried and analyzed data in BigQuery to support development and troubleshooting.
Built an automated monitoring and alerting system on Google Cloud Platform using cloud functions, logging and alerting policies to safeguard uptime.
Containerized and deployed services with Docker and Kubernetes, applying DevOps practices for reliable releases.
Authored API documentation with Sphinx, giving the team a clear reference for development and integration.

work.name: Accenture
work.summary: Built MuleSoft ETL APIs and owned data validation and reconciliation for an automated Salesforce data conversion.
highlights: Built MuleSoft APIs to extract, transform and load data from source systems into a conversion PostgreSQL database.
Developed MuleSoft and SQL transformations to restructure source data for compatibility with the Salesforce target system.
Owned data validation, reconciliation, exception handling and scheduling for the automated conversion process.
Remediated Salesforce orgs to achieve Salesforce Operational Controls compliance.
Classified objects and fields to meet client privacy requirements and compiled Risk Inspector Tool outputs via SOQL queries to surface compliance flags.
Migrated code through the Copado DevOps pipeline and managed the Gerrit review process, analyzing the existing codebase to define use cases and build test cycles.
Led quality assurance across Accenture and third-party vendor development: test execution, defect management and system integration testing.
